newsitem.title: ITALY: Agip makes Egyptian off-shore oil find.
newsitem.headline: Agip makes Egyptian off-shore oil find.

text.p: Agip SpA, a wholly-owned unit of Italian energy group ENI, said on Thursday it had made a new offshore oil find in Egypt's Gulf of Suez.

It said in a statement the oil field, located by Agip's Egyptian associate IEOC, was in the Belayim Field concession close to the Sinai peninsula, which is run by Agip and the Egyptian state energy company EGPC.
Agip said an exploratory well, Belayim Marine 57, had yielded 4,650 barrels per day (bpd) in a test.
The statement said the deeper oil-bearing structures in the field had a productive potential of more than 13,000 barrels per day.
The discovery signalled that there might be more oil deposits in the central and northern sectors of the Belayim concession.
